# CareerCoach AI

> AI-powered interview preparation and learning platform. Practice mock interviews, generate questions, analyze resumes, and master technical topics with a personal AI coach.

CareerCoach AI helps job seekers prepare for technical and behavioral interviews. The product combines an AI assistant, mock interview simulator, question generator, resume analyzer, study plans, flashcards, and analytics in a single workspace.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Overview of study streak, readiness score, and recent activity.
- [AI Assistant](/assistant): Chat-based AI coach for interview questions and concept explanations.
- [Mock Interview](/mock-interview): Live AI-driven mock interview sessions.
- [Question Generator](/question-generator): Generate role-specific interview questions on demand.
- [Quiz](/quiz): Topic-wise quizzes with instant scoring.
- [Resume Analyzer](/resume): Upload a resume and get an ATS score with improvement tips.
- [Documents](/documents): Upload notes, books, and PDFs for retrieval-augmented Q&A.
- [Study Plan](/study-plan): Personalized day-by-day prep plan.
- [Notes Summarizer](/notes): Turn long notes into concise summaries.
- [Flashcards](/flashcards): Spaced-repetition flashcards for key concepts.
- [Bookmarks](/bookmarks): Save and revisit important questions and answers.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Track readiness across topics over time.

## Optional

- [Settings](/settings): Account, preferences, and theme.
